summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories (hubs where models are hosted, versioned, and shared) and developer-facing inference platforms (serverless APIs that run open models on demand). Hugging Face anchors the space as the dominant repository, crossing 3 million public models in August 2026, though download distribution is extremely concentrated — roughly half of all models have under 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly 50% of all downloads. Platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow layer local and cloud inference on top of this open model supply, competing on latency, price-per-token, and model breadth.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository for AI models, datasets, and demo apps (Spaces), plus hosted inference endpoints and a serverless Inference API/Providers router that federates third-party inference backends.
platforms.pricing: Free hosting and public model access; PRO subscription (~$9/mo) for added features; Inference Endpoints billed hourly by compute; Inference Providers billed pay-as-you-go pass-through to partner providers; Enterprise Hub priced per-seat.
features: Largest model, dataset, and Spaces catalog
Git-based model versioning and model cards
Transformers, Diffusers, and Hub Python libraries
Serverless Inference Providers router across partner backends
Dedicated Inference Endpoints for production deployment
Download stats and community collaboration tools
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and teams wanting the broadest model selection, open collaboration, and a single hub to discover, host, fine-tune, and deploy models.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A lightweight tool for running open LLMs locally on your own machine with a simple CLI and local REST API, bundling model weights, config, and quantization into a single pullable package.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ curated models in its library (thousands more importable via GGUF/Modelfile)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees since inference runs on local hardware (Ollama Cloud/Turbo offered for hosted GPU runs).
features: One-command local model pull and run
GGUF-based quantized models for consumer hardware
Modelfile system for custom model configs
Optional hosted cloud inference for larger models
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run and prototype with open models locally without cloud costs or data leaving their machine.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and deploy open-source and community models via API, with easy packaging of custom models using Cog, popular for image, video, audio, and generative media models.
platforms.model_count: Tens of thousands of community-published models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing) or per-output for some models; no subscription required.
features: Run thousands of models via a unified API
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups who want to ship AI features (especially generative media) via API without managing infrastructure, and to deploy their own custom models.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance cloud inference and fine-tuning platform for open models, offering fast serverless LLM APIs, dedicated endpoints, and GPU clusters for training.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ open models (LLMs, vision, image, embeddings, code)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference (tiered by model size); dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters billed hourly; fine-tuning priced per token processed.
features: Fast serverless inference with OpenAI-compatible API
Broad catalog including Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral
Dedicated endpoints and reserved GPU clusters
platforms.best_for: Startups and enterprises building production LLM apps that need fast, scalable, cost-efficient inference and the option to fine-tune or train open models.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A production-grade inference platform optimized for low-latency, high-throughput serving of open LLMs and multimodal models, with its FireAttention engine and fine-tuning tools.
platforms.model_count: ~100+ curated open models plus custom-deployed models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing (by model size); on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed per GPU-hour; fine-tuning and custom deployment fees.
features: Proprietary FireAttention inference engine for low latency
Function calling and structured JSON output
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model deployment
platforms.best_for: Companies needing the lowest-latency, highest-throughput production inference for open models with strong reliability and compliance guarantees.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A cloud inference platform (with strong presence in the Chinese market) offering serverless APIs for a wide range of open LLMs, image, audio, and video models at competitive pricing.
platforms.model_count: ~100+ open models (including DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, FLUX)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / pay-per-use with aggressive low pricing; free tier credits; dedicated/reserved instances available.
features: Strong support for Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
Image, audio, and video generation endpoints
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking low-cost access to leading Chinese and global open models through a single serverless API.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware delivering exceptionally fast token generation for a curated set of open models.
platforms.model_count: ~30+ curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Whisper, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing with a free developer tier; enterprise/on-prem LPU options.
features: Custom LPU hardware for ultra-low latency
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time or latency-sensitive applications (chat, agents, voice) that need the fastest possible inference speeds.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API router and marketplace that aggregates hundreds of models from many open and proprietary providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic fallback and price routing.
platforms.model_count: ~400+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pass-through pricing with a small routing margin; prepaid credits; some free-tier models.
features: Single API across many inference providers
Automatic provider failover and load balancing
Transparent per-model pricing and uptime stats
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to many open and closed models through one API with built-in redundancy and cost optimization.
